question: Four words are given, out of which only one word is spelt correct. Choose the correct spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"MEMENTO"** is correctly spelt. It means an object kept as a reminder of a person or event. (स्मृति चिन्ह)

 
 
• **Example:** She kept the ticket stub as a **memento** of her first concert.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **PERCIEVE** (अनुभव करना): The correct spelling is** "PERCEIVE"** which means to become aware or conscious of something.

 
 
• **Example:** She could perceive the tension in the room as soon as she walked in.
 
 
 
• **OUTRAGOUS** (अपमानजनक): The correct spelling is **"OUTRAGEOUS"** which means shockingly bad or excessive.
 
 
• **Example:** His outrageous behavior was not acceptable in the office.
 
 
 
• **PLAGERIZE** (साहित्यिक चोरी करना): The correct spelling is **"PLAGIARIZE" **which means to take someone else's work or ideas and pass them off as one's own.
 
 
• **Example:** It is unethical to** plagiarize** content from the internet for your assignments.
